title: The Chern character of a coherent sheaf on a smooth projective hypersurface
summary: Given a coherent sheaf on a smooth projective hypersurface X, we prove an explicit formula for its Chern character as a Cech cocycle in terms of the free resolution of the associated module and calculate its image in the Jacobian ring under the Griffiths residue map. The formula is a geometric analogue of the Kapustin-Li formula for Landau-Ginzburg models, but proven directly using Hodge-theoretic techniques.
